label: training-gym-r34-complete
context:
Training Gym R34 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10.

R34 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. floyd-warshall-001 (T6) - All-pairs shortest path with path reconstruction and negative cycle detection. 6 tests.
2. btree-001 (T7) - B-Tree with configurable degree t, insert with node splitting, search. 6 tests.
3. segment-001 (T6) - Segment Tree for range sum queries and point updates. 6 tests.
4. tarjan-001 (T7) - Tarjan's SCC algorithm with lowlink tracking and stack-based component extraction. 6 tests.

KEY PATTERNS:
- Floyd-Warshall: next-hop table for path reconstruction, diagonal check for negative cycles
- B-Tree: split full child BEFORE descending, median promotes to parent, keys=[t-1] splits at position t-1
- Segment Tree: 4*n allocation, node 2i+1 and 2i+2 for children, lazy-free point updates
- Tarjan SCC: lowlink[v]=min(index of nodes reachable from subtree), pop stack until v for SCC extraction

DB: 210 exercises, 375 attempts, avg 9.86
decisions: Floyd-Warshall: use next-hop matrix nxt[i][j] updated when shorter path found via k
B-Tree split: keys[t-1] is median, left gets keys[:t-1], right gets keys[t:]
Segment Tree: store both arr and tree, update modifies both
Tarjan SCC: sort output by (-len, min_vertex) for deterministic ordering
next_steps: Design R35 exercises. Focus on: Fenwick Tree (BIT), Trie with delete, LRU with callbacks, or Rope data structure.
